title: Datasheet → 3D body
summary: Give a placed part a 3D body recreated by a generator from the datasheet's drawing, fitted to the footprint it keeps, every value cited.
intents: give J16 a real 3D body from the datasheet
replace the placeholder 3D model of U13
recreate the 3D body of LS1 from its drawing

part.title: Part
part.help: The placed part's designator, e.g. J16

photos.title: Photos
photos.help: Product photo URLs or files to compare the body with, one per line

body_plan.help: The generator and preset that make the body and every value the mechanical drawing states; or, when no shipped generator makes it, why.

generator.help: A generator's name from library.generators; leave it out when none makes this body

preset.help: A preset of that generator, when one is the body

params.help: Parameter values: lengths in integer nanometres, angles in integer millidegrees

pins.help: [{lead, pad}] where a lead lands a pad of another number

missing.help: Without a generator: the body's family and what no shipped generator offers

pages.help: The pages you read, by document: "evqp2.pdf: drawing 2, land pattern 3"

why.help: One line: the body and where its values come from

review_report.help: The review report, as library.review_check checks it.

steps.title: Body
steps.goal: Read the mechanical drawing; choose the generator and preset that make this body and give every value the drawing states, or say why no generator makes it.

steps.title: Report
steps.goal: Write the review report: every body value with its page and figure, confidence and open questions.
